chunks: Such is Our chastisement; and the punishment of the Hereafter will be greater, if only they knew!
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between worldly chastisement and the punishment of the Hereafter according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the superiority of the Hereafter's retribution over worldly trials, serving as a reminder that ignorance of divine reality leads to underestimating the gravity of eternal consequences. It highlights the concept of 'Ayb' (blame) for those who claim knowledge but fail to act upon it, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the continuity of divine justice from this world to the next.
